entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea made lentil soup while I was stuck in bed with a fever 🍲

entries.author: bea
entries.text: The kettle was already boiled when I came down this morning. Small thing, huge thing.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: We finally hung the big mirror in the hallway. Took three tries and a lot of laughing.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada drove two hours to pick me up after the train got cancelled.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: snow!!! ❄️ built a lopsided snowman in the yard

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Grateful for the quiet Sunday. No plans, just books and the radiator ticking.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: She remembered the name of my childhood dog and asked about him.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Our neighbour returned the ladder with a jar of honey as thanks.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Got the job offer!! Bea screamed louder than I did 🎉

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada fixed the leaking tap in the bathroom without watching a single video.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Long walk by the river at dusk, herons everywhere.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: My sister called just to say she misses us.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea let me pick the film even though it was my turn last time too.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Fresh bread from the bakery on the corner, still warm.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: We danced in the kitchen to an old song while the pasta boiled over.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada stayed up late to help me finish the grant application.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: The cat finally sat on my lap. Only for a minute but still 🐈

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Planted tulip bulbs along the fence. Fingers crossed for spring.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea wrote a little poem on the fridge whiteboard.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Paid off the last of the car loan today.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Thunderstorm at night and we watched it from the window with the lights off.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada's mum taught me how to make her dumplings.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Got through the dentist appointment without panicking. Bea held my hand in the waiting room.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: We found a twenty in an old coat pocket and spent it on ice cream 🍦

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Clean sheets day. Best day.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: The physio said my knee is healing faster than expected.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea surprised me with tickets to the jazz trio I love.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Sat on the balcony with coffee and watched the sunrise.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: We argued about the dishes, then talked it through properly. Feels lighter now.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada carried all the shopping up four flights so my back could rest.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: First swim of the year in the cold lake. Screamed. Loved it.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: My old teacher replied to my letter after all these years.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea's laugh when the toddler next door waved at her 😂

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Picnic in the park with cheese, grapes and too much cake.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Power cut all evening, so we played cards by candlelight.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada booked the train for our anniversary weekend by the sea.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Finished the jigsaw puzzle: a thousand pieces of sky.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: A stranger helped me push the car when it wouldn't start.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea ironed my shirt before the interview without me asking.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Tomatoes from the balcony pots! Three whole ones 🍅

entries.author: ada
entries.text: We video called Grandad and he showed us his new hearing aid.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Rain all day. Soup, blanket, podcast. Perfect.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea forgave me for forgetting to post her parcel.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Our friend Tom moved back to town!

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Fell asleep on the sofa and woke up tucked under a blanket.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ran my first 5k without stopping 🏃‍♀️

entries.author: ada
entries.text: The landlord agreed to fix the boiler before winter.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: Ada sang badly in the shower and I couldn't stop smiling.

entries.author: ada
entries.text: Bea's pancakes on a Tuesday for no reason at all.

entries.author: bea
entries.text: We sat in the car outside the house just talking for an hour.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Baby slept four hours straight 😴🙏

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal took the night feed so I could rest.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Biscuit (the dog) learned to sit on command. Finally.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: My best friend dropped off a lasagne and didn't stay, which was exactly right.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: first smile!!!! 🥹

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Hot shower, uninterrupted. Luxury.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Dee's dad came round and assembled the cot while we napped.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: The health visitor said she's gaining weight nicely.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Walked the dog at sunrise and the fields were full of mist.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal hoovered the whole flat without being asked.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Got a pay rise. Not huge but it helps with nappies 😅

entries.author: dee
entries.text: We ate takeaway noodles on the floor at midnight, giggling like teenagers.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Our baby grabbed my finger and wouldn't let go.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Mum group at the library, finally adults to talk to!

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Fixed the wobbly table leg with a folded beer mat. Engineering.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal wrote down every feed time in a notebook so I didn't have to remember.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Sunny afternoon in the garden with the pram under the apple tree 🌳

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Biscuit gently sniffed the baby and then lay down beside her. My heart.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Dee laughed at my terrible pun for once.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: A nurse on the phone line stayed calm and talked me through the fever.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Grandma knitted a yellow blanket. It's enormous.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: We had a whole conversation that wasn't about the baby.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Old mate from uni messaged out of nowhere. Made my week.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Slept in until nine because Cal took the early shift.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: bath time splashes everywhere 🛁 soaked and happy

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal brought me flowers from the market, the orange ones I like.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Car passed its MOT with no repairs needed. Miracle.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: The neighbours' kid drew us a picture of the baby. Stick legs and all.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Rainy day, so we built a blanket fort and read picture books.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: First proper coffee in months. I could cry.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Dee managed a short run around the block today. So proud of her.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal's boss let him work from home on Fridays.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: The baby said something that sounded a lot like 'dada'.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Freezer full of meals that my sister cooked for us.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Sunday roast at Dee's parents. Nobody had to cook at home.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: We found a babysitter we actually trust.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Took the bins out and saw a fox trotting down the road.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal sang lullabies off-key and she still fell asleep.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Paid the nursery deposit. Scary but done.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Tiny socks drying on the radiator. Ridiculously cute.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Dee let me nap after my night shift at the warehouse.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: We watched the first episode of a new series and stayed awake till the end!

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Biscuit stole a whole sausage off the counter. Furious and also laughing.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: The baby rolled over on her own 🎉

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Friends threw us a tiny party to meet the little one.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Cal cleaned the bottles and set them out for morning.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Quiet drive to the coast while she slept in the back.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Washing machine repairman came the same day. Bless him.

entries.author: cal
entries.text: Dee read my CV and found three typos before I sent it.

entries.author: dee
entries.text: Wrote a letter to the baby for her first birthday, to open when she's older.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Fay stayed up past 2am her time just to watch the match with me over video.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: A parcel arrived from Eli with my favourite crisps from home and a handwritten card.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Passed my driving test on the second attempt! 🚗

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Eli sent a voice note of the birds outside his window so I could hear home.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Counted the days on the calendar: only forty until I fly out to see her.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: My flatmate taught me to make proper dal and we ate it on the roof.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: We read the same novel and talked about the ending for an hour.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Got a distinction on my dissertation proposal 🎓

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Fay calmed me down when I was spiralling about the move.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Watched a film 'together' by pressing play at the same second. Very nerdy, very sweet.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Found a cheap flight in March. Booked it before I could overthink.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Snowfall here for the first time this winter. I sent Eli forty photos of it ❄️

entries.author: eli
entries.text: My brother helped me move all my furniture into the new place.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: The library stayed open late during exams and someone left free biscuits.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Fay drew a little map of her neighbourhood so I can picture where she walks.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Eli's mum texted to ask how my exams went.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Hit a personal best at the climbing wall.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Hugging Eli at arrivals after five months. No words.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: We cooked the same recipe in two kitchens and compared results on camera.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Lost my bank card, and the café owner let me pay next week.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Woke up to a long message from Fay about why she's proud of me.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Sunset over the harbour, pink and gold. Wish he'd been here.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Fixed my bike chain myself for the first time.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Professor said my essay was the most original in the class!

entries.author: eli
entries.text: We played an online word game until we were both yawning 😴

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Eli remembered my exam timetable and texted good luck before each one.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Spent the weekend with her in person. Walked everywhere. Feet ache, heart full.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Homesick day, but Eli just stayed on the call while I cried.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Got a plant for the new flat. Named it Fay Junior 🌱

entries.author: fay
entries.text: The bus driver waited for me when I was running late.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Fay's friends said hello on the call and they already know my name.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Booked the summer internship. Nervous, thrilled.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Grandma's birthday lunch; everyone asked about Fay.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Long bath, face mask, early night. Self-care win.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: A colleague covered my shift so I could take Fay's call on her birthday.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Saw a busker play our song outside the station 🎶

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Paid my first month's rent on my own. Feels grown-up.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Eli mailed me a scarf because he heard it was freezing here.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Ran into my old football coach and he remembered me.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: My presentation went well and my hands didn't shake.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Fay planned a virtual date with candles on both ends. Ridiculous and lovely 🕯️

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Market haul: figs, olives and a loaf the size of my head.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Storm knocked the fence down but the neighbours helped prop it up.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Finished the semester. Slept twelve hours.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Practised her language with an app so I can talk to her parents.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Eli sent breakfast to my door via delivery on a hard morning.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: We talked about where to live after she graduates and it felt exciting, not scary.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: My landlady brought me soup when I had a cold.

entries.author: eli
entries.text: Laughed so hard at Fay's impression of her professor that I cried.

entries.author: fay
entries.text: Countdown app says 12 days. Packing already.
